missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Гора' is the feminine nominative subject. 'Высокая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'очень' intensifies the description.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Гору' is the accusative direct object of 'видим'. 'Красивую' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'вдали' adds distance.
Strategic focus: Genitive with preposition. 'Горы' is the genitive of 'гора' after 'с вершины'. The impersonal 'видно' presents what can be seen, namely 'море'.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Горе' is the dative of 'гора' after 'к', marking the goal of motion. 'Высокой' agrees in the feminine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with location. 'Горой' is the instrumental of 'гора' after 'за', meaning behind. 'Высокой' agrees in the feminine instrumental, and 'деревня' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Горе' is the prepositional of 'гора' after 'на'. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine prepositional, and 'снег' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Гора' is the feminine nominative subject of 'закрывает'. 'Высокая' agrees in the feminine nominative, and 'солнце' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Горах' is the prepositional plural of 'гора' after 'в', the fixed way to say in the mountains. 'Отдыхать' names the activity.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Горы' is the nominative plural of 'гора' as the subject of 'виднеются'. 'Заснеженные' agrees in the plural, and 'вдали' adds distance.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Горы' is the accusative plural of the inanimate 'гора', the object of 'покорили'. 'Эти высокие' agree in the plural.
